options.label: Exchange 性能计数器
options.description: 在 Exchange 服务器本机通过 telegraf_windows 的 win_perf_counters 采集 MSExchange 队列/OWA 等计数器，不能远程无代理采集。
options.description_en: Collect MSExchange queue/OWA counters with local telegraf_windows win_perf_counters on the Exchange host. Agentless remote collection is not supported.

options.label: OWA/EWS 探测
options.description: 在 Exchange 本机用 Telegraf http_response 探测 OWA 与 EWS URL。
options.description_en: Probe OWA and EWS URLs locally with Telegraf http_response.

form_fields.name: host
form_fields.label: 主机名
form_fields.description: 用于默认 OWA/EWS URL 的主机名或 FQDN。留空则探测本机 https://127.0.0.1/owa 与 https://127.0.0.1/EWS/Exchange.asmx。采集器必须安装在 Exchange Windows 主机上。
form_fields.guide_short: HTTPS 证书按主机名校验时请填 FQDN；留空探测 127.0.0.1。telegraf_windows 必须装在 Exchange 本机。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Use the Exchange FQDN when TLS hostname checks matter. Leave empty to probe 127.0.0.1. telegraf_windows must still run on the Exchange host.
form_fields.description_en: Hostname or FQDN used in default OWA/EWS URLs. Leave empty to probe https://127.0.0.1/owa and https://127.0.0.1/EWS/Exchange.asmx on this host. telegraf_windows must run on the Exchange Windows host.

form_fields.name: owa_url
form_fields.label: OWA URL
form_fields.description: OWA 探测地址。留空则使用 https://<host>/owa；host 也为空时使用 https://127.0.0.1/owa。
form_fields.guide_short: 默认 https://<host>/owa，host 为空则为 https://127.0.0.1/owa。telegraf_windows 必须装在 Exchange 本机。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Defaults to https://<host>/owa, or https://127.0.0.1/owa when host is empty. Install telegraf_windows on the Exchange host.
form_fields.description_en: OWA probe URL. Leave empty to use https://<host>/owa, or https://127.0.0.1/owa when host is empty.

form_fields.name: ews_url
form_fields.label: EWS URL
form_fields.description: EWS 探测地址。留空则使用 https://<host>/EWS/Exchange.asmx；host 也为空时使用 https://127.0.0.1/EWS/Exchange.asmx。
form_fields.guide_short: 默认 https://<host>/EWS/Exchange.asmx，host 为空则为 https://127.0.0.1/EWS/Exchange.asmx。telegraf_windows 必须装在 Exchange 本机。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Defaults to https://<host>/EWS/Exchange.asmx, or https://127.0.0.1/EWS/Exchange.asmx when host is empty. Install telegraf_windows on the Exchange host.
form_fields.description_en: EWS probe URL. Leave empty to use https://<host>/EWS/Exchange.asmx, or https://127.0.0.1/EWS/Exchange.asmx when host is empty.

form_fields.name: insecure_skip_verify
form_fields.label: 跳过证书校验
form_fields.guide_short: 仅 HTTPS 自签或证书链不完整时开启。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enable only for self-signed or incomplete HTTPS certificate chains.

form_fields.name: interval
form_fields.label: 间隔
form_fields.description: 监控数据的采集时间间隔（单位：秒）

widget_props.placeholder: 请选择 Windows 节点（已安装 telegraf_windows）
widget_props.placeholder_en: Select the Windows node with telegraf_windows
